messages:
Elena (docs): I opened a small PR to document recommended packaging of CA bundles for air-gapped Private installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3102

Kai: Nice. Can you include exact concat order (leaf, intermediates, root) and a systemd env example to point the agent at the bundled CA?

Elena (docs): Done. Added example command and systemd snippet:

`cat intermediate.pem root.pem > /tmp/ca_bundle.pem`

systemd env: `Environment=REDWOOD_KMS_CA=/etc/redwood/certs/ca_bundle.pem`

Morgan: Suggest adding a verify step for Support: `openssl verify -CAfile /etc/redwood/certs/ca_bundle.pem /etc/redwood/certs/client.crt` and a curl mutual TLS quickcheck.

Elena (docs): Added both: `curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca_bundle.pem https://kms.local/health`

Infra Bot: preflight-run started for docs-pr-3102 - status: queued

Kai: Also note file perms: `chown root:root && chmod 600 /etc/redwood/certs/client.key` and ownership for the bundle. Customers trip on permissions during air-gapped installs.

Elena (docs): Added permissions note and a short troubleshooting box: order of certs, permissions, env var, verify commands. Ready to merge after preflight.

Infra Bot: preflight-run result: passed 44D - docs-pr-3102 - run-517

Elena (docs): Merged. I'll add a Support KB linking these checks.
